objective: Run garak with mock models to validate the minimal LLM security evaluation workflow.

scans.name: minimal_connectivity_scan
scans.risk_comment: Minimal risk in this connectivity-only mock scan.

scans.name: prompt_injection_mock_scan
scans.risk_comment: Immediate risk in the mock echo model because injected rogue strings are repeated in model output.

what_is_proven: The garak toolchain is installed and executable.
A model target can be selected and invoked in batch by garak.
Attack probes can generate adversarial prompts.
Detectors can decide whether the generated output contains attack success signals.
JSONL and HTML security scan reports can be produced for later analysis.
what_is_not_proven: This does not evaluate a real production LLM.
This does not yet evaluate a real RAG or Agent application.
The prompt injection failure is expected because test.Repeat is a deliberately unsafe echo mock model.
